description: Source code implementing optimized BLAKE3 hash functions using ARM Neon intrinsics for performance on little-endian ARM architectures. Includes inline functions for vector operations, Neon-based hashing routines for processing multiple blocks in parallel, and support functions for loading, storing, and manipulating 128-bit vectors.

methods.name: INLINE uint32x4_t loadu_128(const uint8_t src[16])
methods.description: Loads 16 bytes into a Neon vector using memcpy to avoid alignment issues.

methods.name: INLINE void storeu_128(uint32x4_t src,uint8_t dest[16])
methods.description: Stores a Neon vector into 16 bytes of memory using memcpy.

methods.name: INLINE uint32x4_t xor_128(uint32x4_t a,uint32x4_t b)
methods.description: Performs element-wise XOR operation on 128-bit vectors.

methods.name: INLINE uint32x4_t set1_128(uint32_t x)
methods.description: Creates a 128-bit vector with all elements set to the same 32-bit value.

methods.name: INLINE uint32x4_t set4(uint32_t a,uint32_t b,uint32_t c,uint32_t d)
methods.description: Creates a 128-bit vector from four 32-bit values.

methods.name: INLINE uint32x4_t rot16_128(uint32x4_t x)
methods.description: Rotates each 32-bit lane of the vector by 16 bits.

methods.name: INLINE uint32x4_t rot12_128(uint32x4_t x)
methods.description: Rotates each 32-bit lane of the vector by 12 bits.

methods.name: INLINE uint32x4_t rot8_128(uint32x4_t x)
methods.description: Rotates each 32-bit lane of the vector by 8 bits.

methods.name: INLINE uint32x4_t rot7_128(uint32x4_t x)
methods.description: Rotates each 32-bit lane of the vector by 7 bits.

methods.name: INLINE void round_fn4(uint32x4_t v[16],uint32x4_t m[16],size_t r)
methods.description: Performs a round of the hashing algorithm on four vectors, applying message schedule and rotations.

methods.name: INLINE void transpose_vecs_128(uint32x4_t vecs[4])
methods.description: Transposes four 128-bit vectors as part of message processing.

methods.name: INLINE void transpose_msg_vecs4(const uint8_t * const * inputs,size_t block_offset,uint32x4_t out[16])
methods.description: Loads and transposes four message vectors from input arrays.

methods.name: INLINE void load_counters4(uint64_t counter,bool increment_counter,uint32x4_t * out_low,uint32x4_t * out_high)
methods.description: Loads counter values into Neon vectors, optionally incrementing counters.

methods.name: void blake3_hash4_neon(const uint8_t * const * inputs,size_t blocks,const uint32_t key[8],uint64_t counter,bool increment_counter,uint8_t flags,uint8_t flags_start,uint8_t flags_end,uint8_t * out)
methods.description: Processes four blocks in parallel using Neon intrinsics, updating hash state.

methods.name: INLINE void hash_one_neon(const uint8_t * input,size_t blocks,const uint32_t key[8],uint64_t counter,uint8_t flags,uint8_t flags_start,uint8_t flags_end,uint8_t out[BLAKE3_OUT_LEN])
methods.description: Hashes a single input block(s) with Neon optimization, calling a portable compression routine.

methods.name: void blake3_hash_many_neon(const uint8_t * const * inputs,size_t num_inputs,size_t blocks,const uint32_t key[8],uint64_t counter,bool increment_counter,uint8_t flags,uint8_t flags_start,uint8_t flags_end,uint8_t * out)
methods.description: Handles multiple inputs and processes them in parallel, batching with Neon.
